scripts/lib/notion-mdx.test.ts.name: Notion block renderer tests
scripts/lib/notion-mdx.test.ts.description: Checks, fixture by fixture, how the Notion block renderer turns FAQ blocks and rich text into MDX.

scripts/lib/page-schema.test.ts.name: Page frontmatter schema tests
scripts/lib/page-schema.test.ts.description: Checks arbitrumPageSchema keeps third_party_content_owner, target_audience and user_story optional and intact through parsing.

scripts/lib/precompile-tables.test.ts.name: Precompile table tests
scripts/lib/precompile-tables.test.ts.description: Checks the parser that reads Nitro precompile sources and the renderer that writes the precompile method tables.

scripts/lib/redirects-config.test.ts.name: Redirects config tests
scripts/lib/redirects-config.test.ts.description: Runs offline checks over redirects.config.ts and the .md twins next.config.ts derives from it.

scripts/lib/references-check.test.ts.name: References check tests
scripts/lib/references-check.test.ts.description: Spawns scripts/references-check.ts in throwaway trees to check glossary id rules R1 and R4 and the ESM-imported partial rule R3.

scripts/lib/root-routing.test.ts.name: Root routing tests
scripts/lib/root-routing.test.ts.description: Checks root-level article URLs never collide with machine routes or public files and the markdown rewrite still accepts them.

scripts/lib/shared.test.ts.name: Sidebar resource link tests
scripts/lib/shared.test.ts.description: Tripwire that each sidebarResourceLinks entry pinned in the sidebar footer resolves to a real page and has a label.

scripts/lib/site-url.test.ts.name: Site URL rule tests
scripts/lib/site-url.test.ts.description: Checks resolveSiteUrl throws in a production build without NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, and that getSiteUrl and next.config.ts apply it.

scripts/lib/strip-code.test.ts.name: Code stripper tests
scripts/lib/strip-code.test.ts.description: Checks stripCode blanks fences and code spans by CommonMark rules while preserving source length and line count.

scripts/lib/var-links.test.ts.name: Var link tests
scripts/lib/var-links.test.ts.description: Checks expandVarPlaceholders and remarkVarLinks rewrite {var:} link, href and src destinations and register vars.json as a dependency.

scripts/move-doc.test.ts.name: Move doc tests
scripts/move-doc.test.ts.description: Runs the real move-doc CLI against a throwaway fixture repo and checks the pages, links, meta.json and redirect it leaves on disk.

scripts/sidebar.test.ts.name: Sidebar tree tests
scripts/sidebar.test.ts.description: Builds the Fumadocs page tree from the real meta.json files and fails on an unlisted page, a duplicated node or a page outside every root.

scripts/static-docs-http.test.ts.name: Static docs HTTP tests
scripts/static-docs-http.test.ts.description: Fetches a running next start build to check routing, legacy URLs, headers, metadata, markdown mirrors and page weight.

tests/browser/ai-chat.test.ts.name: AI chat panel browser tests
tests/browser/ai-chat.test.ts.description: Drives Chromium against next start to check the AI panel opens, lazy-loads once and takes hand-offs from Inkeep search.

tests/browser/findable-panels.test.ts.name: Findable panel browser tests
tests/browser/findable-panels.test.ts.description: Drives Chromium against next start to check browser find reveals collapsed tabs and accordions without breaking manual toggling.

tests/browser/link-preview.test.ts.name: Link preview browser tests
tests/browser/link-preview.test.ts.description: Drives Chromium against next start to check hovering an internal link shows its card, Term popovers win, and Escape closes it.
